title_en: Protecting the Environment Starts at Home
note_en: 把 + object + verb + 成/变成 describes turning something into something else: 把垃圾分成可回收物、厨余垃圾和其他垃圾 "sort trash into recyclables, food waste and other waste," and 把环保活动变成邻居之间交流的机会 "turn environmental activities into a chance for neighbors to get to know each other." English simply says "turn X into Y," but in Chinese a result complement like 成 after the verb usually requires 把 to bring the object in front of the verb.
